{{Quote|I've discovered ancient knowledge. Jedi concentration, this is a fantastic find! With this knowledge I can convert enemy buildings to our side.|Qui-Gon Jinn, if the player finds the ancient grove|audio=JediConcentration.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
'''Jedi Concentration''', also known as '''Sith Concentration''' when used by [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], was an ancient [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] accessible by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. It allowed its user to wield [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to convert buildings and heavy weapons controlled by an enemy faction to their alignment. Knowledge of Jedi Concentration could be found at an [[ancient grove]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]].<ref name="GB" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}
Between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of the [[Alaris Prime colonial war|war]] on [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], as portrayed in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]].</ref> the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]] of Alaris Prime uncovered a [[Jedi holocron (Alaris Prime)|holocron]] which revealed that the ancient grove was near a [[Unidentified Wookiee base (fortress)|base]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], who had arrived at the base to aid the Wookiees in their [[Battle for Alaris Prime|battle]] against the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], was able to take the path to the grove and learn the power of Jedi Concentration. Jinn was delighted by the discovery and was able to use the ability against the Trade Federation.<ref name="GB" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Jedi Concentration appeared in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''. It can be researched at either a [[Jedi temple/Legends|Jedi]] or [[Sith temple/Legends|Sith Temple]] at the cost of 350 [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal Naboo]],<ref name="GB" /> and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the [[2002]] expansion [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|''Clone Campaigns'']]<ref name="CC">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''</ref> are the only civilizations which can access Jedi/Sith Concentration in the standard game settings. An image of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]<ref name="GB" /> using the Force on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] from the [[1980]] film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> is used to represent the upgrade in ''Galactic Battlegrounds''.<ref name="GB" />

In the seventh level of the Wookiee tutorial campaign, "The Battle for Alaris Prime," the player can optionally access Jedi Concentration by sending Qui-Gon Jinn to the ancient grove.<ref name="GB" />
